turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm going back to work after staying home with my kids for five years. How do I explain the gap?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Be direct and positive. Say you took time to raise your children and you're excited to get back to work.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Won't they think my skills are out of date?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Show them otherwise. Mention any courses, volunteering or projects you did, even small ones.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did run the fundraising for the school

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's great experience. Talk about how much you raised and how you organized the volunteers.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I never thought of that as real work.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It absolutely is. Planning, budgeting and leading people are exactly what employers look for.
